_comment: MG-23 blocker 1 fixture — MUST FAIL (nonzero). planned_values is a STRING while resource_changes is a valid array, so the document still satisfies the presence probe via resource_changes. Before the fix this exited nonzero only incidentally: `.planned_values.root_module?` on a string produced jq `empty`, which made the whole boolean expression produce empty, which left has_shape as the empty string and tripped the shape die. That is a correct outcome reached by accident — a jq expression evaluating to empty rather than false. The TYPE validation now rejects it deliberately, naming planned_values and its actual type.
